text:
jen: Quick sync — pricing experiments checklist. We want to land FAQ updates, two new tier name options, and a simpler calculator before the launch post next Tue. Can folks confirm availability? :spiral_calendar:

omar: I can draft the launch post and the benchmark narrative. Do we have target benchmarks (latency/cost) we want quoted?

brandon: For the benchmark callouts: use 95th latency (hosted) and median token cost. Current numbers I recommend: `95th=120ms`, `cost/token=$0.0008`. These are provisional — I'll validate with infra tomorrow.

kai: Re: tier names — proposal A: "Core / Scale / Enterprise". Proposal B: "Starter / Developer / Dedicated". We should test which aligns better with self-serve vs. sales-led funnels. Also the calculator needs an option for "dedicated capacity" commit slider.

leah: Webinar planning: I can host a 30min demo + Q&A on Thu (two weeks out). We need the FAQ to include: data privacy for Private, SLA bullets for Dedicated, and migration path from hosted. Also add a CTA to route high-usage signups to AE queue.

jen: Good. For inbound routing: rule idea — if monthly tokens > 500M OR selected "Dedicated" in calculator, tag as `sales:review`. Otherwise default to nurture flow. Thoughts?

omar: Love that. For the launch post copy I want a short benchmark blurb: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and half the usual per-token cost on typical workloads." Will make two variants: aggressive and conservative.

brandon: Analytics note: A/B will need tracking params `?exp=price_v2` and custom events: `calculator_submit`, `tier_select`, `lead_route`. I'll create the segment and share cohort IDs.

marketing-bot: Staging preview available — https://staging.redwood.ai/pricing/experiment-1768 (password: `staging1768`)

kai: UX ask — calculator should surface an estimated monthly spend + recommended quantization tier. Small copy idea next to tier: "Better performance for long contexts" vs "Lower cost for short queries".

leah: Inbound flow detail: route flagged leads to /sales/ops with a Slack webhook to #sales-inbound and create a ticket in CRM with `lead_score=auto`. I'll draft the webhook payload.

omar: Can we also do a mini microsurvey after calc submit: "What are you building? (one-line)" This will help qualify intent for webinar invites.

jen: Action items:
- @brandon validate benchmark numbers by EOD Fri (owner: brandon)
- @omar draft 2 launch post variants + benchmark paragraph (owner: omar)
- @kai update calculator prototype with commit slider + CTA for Dedicated (owner: kai)
- @leah schedule webinar, draft FAQ bullets & routing webhook (owner: leah)
- @jen wire up routing rules and confirm AB flagging (owner: jen)

jen: Thanks — if we can all hit these by next Fri we can soft-launch to early customers the following week. :thumbsup:
